newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 13-week bill auction for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 13-week bill auction for Thursday.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Wednesday it set a Dutch-style auction of a three billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills for Thursday.
Minimum price was set at 961,125 crowns for a one million crown bill, putting gross yield at 16.0 percent, and net yield at 12.0 percent.
The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 16.37 percent on Thursday, down from 16.57 on Wednesday.
